headline: Sensex surges 1,300 points and Nifty hits 8-month high on FII inflows and strong Q2 earnings

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Optimism over foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows into Indian equities
Strong Q2 earnings reports from major companies like Hindustan Copper and Tata Power
A decline in global oil prices boosting market sentiment
Rally in financial and automobile stocks leading the benchmark indices higher
whatHappening: Sensex jumped over 1,300 points to approach the 82,000 level
Nifty 50 crossed 25,350, reaching its highest level in eight months
Hindustan Copper's profit rose 47% to Rs 520 crore due to margin expansion
ITC increased prices for Gold Flake premium cigarettes by Rs 10 per pack
summary: Indian stock markets rallied sharply as the Sensex gained over 1,300 points, driven by strong FII inflows and positive Q2 results. Metal and power stocks like Hindustan Copper and Tata Power saw significant profit growth, boosting investor confidence. Cooling oil prices and gains in the banking and auto sectors further propelled the indices to multi-month highs.
